sections.title: Your Color Palette
preview: Each one is specified by finish as well as by colour, because the same pigment reads differently in matte than it does in satin.
The report gives the exact codes, the sheen level for every surface, and the order to apply them in.

sections.title: The 5 Mistakes People With Your Style Make
preview: It sounds obvious written down, and it is still the thing that costs people the most to undo once the units are in.
The remaining four are ranked by what they cost to fix, cheapest correction first.

sections.title: Materials & Combinations
preview: Get that ratio right and the rest of the room falls into place around it without much effort at all.
The report names the products, the two combinations to avoid entirely, and what to ask a supplier for.

sections.title: Get the Look: Your Shopping List
preview: Everything else can wait until the room is in and you can see what it actually still needs.
The list is ordered by how much each item changes the room, not by what happens to be cheapest.

sections.title: Your Style DNA Breakdown
preview: It shows up in the choices you made quickly, far more than in the ones you sat and deliberated over.
The breakdown scores both influences and explains exactly where they pull against each other.

sections.title: What to Splurge On vs. Where to Save
preview: The difference is invisible in a showroom and obvious after two years of using the room every day.
The report splits the budget line by line, with a sensible floor and ceiling for each one.
